info.title: bi-platform API
info.description: Contrato HTTP vigente. Única fuente de tipos para servidor y cliente.

post.description: Solo feature dev-auth. Requiere Origin configurado; selecciona identidad sintética sin contraseña. Rota la sesión anterior.

200.description: Sesión creada; cookie HttpOnly SameSite=Strict y Secure con HTTPS

403.description: Origin ausente o distinto al configurado

503.description: No se pudo crear la sesión, o metadatos no listos (`metadata_not_ready`)

get.description: Solo feature dev-auth con BI_DEV_USERS configurado; únicamente fixtures sintéticos.

403.description: Origin ausente o distinto al configurado

503.description: PostgreSQL no disponible, o metadatos no listos (`metadata_not_ready`)

get.summary: Recarga metrics/*.yaml, *.yml y *.json del proyecto y compila cada archivo con el catálogo analítico real.
get.description: Requiere `view` sobre `Model::"project:catalog"`: inspección del catálogo completo del proyecto, incluidos archivos inválidos y metadatos confidenciales o restringidos. No concede consultar, visualizar ni extraer datos. La decisión se toma antes de leer `metrics/` y se audita antes de responder.

200.description: Estado del proyecto y resultados por archivo; sin configuración, lista vacía. Directorio inaccesible o límites globales: project_status unavailable y diagnóstico; nunca resultados parciales.

403.description: Sin permiso para revisar el catálogo del proyecto (`models_forbidden`); sin nada del catálogo

503.description: Motor no disponible, lectura fallida, políticas o miembros ilegibles o inválidos (`policies_invalid`), auditoría no disponible (`audit_unavailable`) o metadatos no listos (`metadata_not_ready`)

504.description: Tiempo agotado al revisar los permisos o al compilar

get.description: Acción session:login, recurso sesión propia. Requiere state, code y cookie temporal; consume el intento atómicamente antes del intercambio. Solo redirige a /.

303.description: Sesión de servidor creada; cookie HttpOnly SameSite=Strict

503.description: Proveedor, PostgreSQL o capacidad de intentos no disponible, o metadatos no listos (`metadata_not_ready`)

get.description: Acción session:login, recurso sesión propia; público, no revela secretos.

post.description: Acción session:login, recurso sesión propia. Origin obligatorio. PKCE S256, nonce y state con vida de cinco minutos. Redirección fija.

200.description: URL del proveedor y cookie temporal HttpOnly

503.description: Proveedor, PostgreSQL o capacidad de intentos no disponible, o metadatos no listos (`metadata_not_ready`)

post.summary: Consulta agregada tipada sobre un dataset permitido; sin SQL del cliente.

200.description: Resultado tipado y exacto; fases en la cabecera `Server-Timing` (plan, queue, execute, serialize; ms)

403.description: Origin ausente o distinto al configurado (`origin_forbidden`), o vía cerrada fuera del desarrollo sintético local (`legacy_query_disabled`)

422.description: Consulta fuera del catálogo o de los límites (`invalid_query`), resultado mayor que el presupuesto de bytes (`result_too_large`) o memoria de consulta agotada (`query_memory_limit`)

503.description: Motor analítico no disponible, metadatos no listos (`metadata_not_ready`) o denegación que no pudo registrarse en la auditoría (`audit_unavailable`)

504.description: Superó el tiempo máximo y se canceló

get.summary:
Lists what the session can use of the project: the projection of #139,
answered once its audit event is confirmed (#140).

200.description: Modelos, métricas y campos que las consultas de esta sesión aceptan, cada uno con lo que puede hacer con ellos; solo después de confirmar su evento de auditoría. Vacío es válido y no indica qué se oculta. Sin proyecto, `not_configured` vacío

429.description: `models_busy`: sin capacidad para compilar el proyecto

503.description: `policies_invalid`, `catalog_unavailable` (proyecto o uno de sus archivos ilegible, o motor no utilizable) o `audit_unavailable`: sin catálogo. Un archivo cuya definición no compila queda fuera del catálogo, sin nombrarlo ni contarlo, y los demás modelos siguen disponibles

504.description: `semantic_timeout`: el catálogo superó el tiempo máximo

post.summary: Explains a semantic query without executing it.

403.description: Un uso no permitido. Sin permiso de inspección del catálogo, solo si todo lo que la consulta nombra (y lo que unen los roles que escribe) es visible para la sesión con `view` o `view_masked`; si no, responde el 404. Lo que el plan lee por linaje se deniega sin nombre

404.description: `model_not_found`: el modelo no existe en el proyecto, o la consulta no se puede explicar a esta sesión. Sin permiso de inspección del catálogo (`view` sobre `Model::"project:catalog"`), un archivo del proyecto ausente o inválido, cualquier fallo al enlazar la consulta con el modelo (nombres desconocidos o ambiguos incluidos) y un miembro o un rol hacia datos que la sesión no puede ver responden igual, con el detalle fijo «No se puede explicar la consulta solicitada.»: no confirma qué existe

422.description: Petición con formato inválido; consulta incorrecta sobre miembros visibles; con permiso de inspección del catálogo, también modelo con errores y fallos al enlazar la consulta

503.description: Políticas no válidas, motor o auditoría no disponibles, o metadatos no listos (`metadata_not_ready`)

post.summary:
Executes a semantic query and answers its exact result with its
receipt, once its audit event is confirmed (#138).

200.description: Resultado exacto completo, recibo y avisos; solo después de confirmar su evento de auditoría. Sin `limit`, una consulta con dimensiones recibe 1000 filas ordenadas por sus dimensiones; nunca más de 10000

403.description: Un uso no permitido, con las mismas reglas de divulgación que explain

404.description: `model_not_found`: el modelo no existe o la consulta no se puede ejecutar para esta sesión. Sin permiso de inspección del catálogo, todo fallo que dependa del catálogo responde igual, con el detalle fijo «No se puede ejecutar la consulta solicitada.»

422.description: Petición o consulta inválida (`invalid_request`, `query_invalid`, `query_incorrect`, `query_unplannable`, `model_invalid` con inspección), `limit_invalid` (limit 1–10000, offset hasta 10000), `masked_unsupported`, `temporal_unsupported` o `result_too_large`

429.description: `models_busy` o `semantic_busy`: sin capacidad para preparar o ejecutar

503.description: Políticas no válidas, metadatos no listos, motor no disponible o fallido (`analytics_unavailable`, `analytics_failed`), resultado no verificable (`result_unverified`), `semantic_unavailable` o auditoría no confirmada (`audit_unavailable`): sin resultado ni recibo

504.description: `semantic_timeout`: la consulta superó el tiempo máximo, contado desde su admisión

503.description: PostgreSQL no disponible, o metadatos no listos (`metadata_not_ready`)

get.summary: Liveness: el proceso responde. No consulta dependencias.

Readiness: PostgreSQL accesible, esquema de metadatos compatible con esta versión, rol de metadatos seguro (`metadata_security`, solo en el modo restringido por defecto) y, si está habilitado, el lago analítico listo.
get.description: En el modo restringido el servidor nunca migra: `migrations` exige que las migraciones las haya aplicado `bi-server migrate` con la credencial administrativa, sin versiones fallidas, desconocidas ni con checksum distinto. Mientras no esté listo, las operaciones de `/api/v1` responden 503 `metadata_not_ready`.

503.description: No listo; `checks` indica qué dependencia falla

Capabilities.description:
What a query of this session may do with a member, each decided on its
own: selecting it never implies filtering, grouping or ordering by it.

group.description: Always `false` for a metric: a metric is aggregated, never a group.

replacement.description: Only when the replacement is itself in this catalog.

sunset.description: ISO `YYYY-MM-DD`, when a retirement date is declared.

CatalogMember.description: A metric or field, by the name a query uses for it.

name.description: The name as written in the model.

type.description:
`DECIMAL(p,s)`, `INT64`, `VARCHAR`, `BOOLEAN`, `DATE` or `TIMESTAMPTZ`,
as a query result declares it.

CatalogModel.description: One model with at least one metric the session can use.

model.description: `metrics/<file>`: what a semantic query names as its `model`.

ColumnType.description:
Logical type of a result column. Every non-null value travels as a JSON
string, so `integer` (64- or 128-bit) and `decimal` stay exact in clients.

user_id.description: Selects a configured synthetic identity; this is not password authentication.

masked.description: Selections returned as typed `NULL`, flagged as masked.

roles.description: The roles the project grants to the session's user.

explanation.description: Stable explanation: one line per operator, then type and unit contracts.

model.description: The project file, as `/api/v1/models` lists it (`metrics/ventas.yaml`).

ModelAiContext.description: Context is descriptive, never executable or a semantic name alias.

additionalProperties.description: Unknown keys are preserved without interpretation.

declared_is_time.description: Explicit declaration; null means the datatype supplies the default.

is_time.description: Effective time role for fields/dimensions; null for a metric.

name.description: Ossie declaration name, useful when a dimension has several origins.

path.description: JSON pointer in this Ossie file, identifying the declaration.

fields.description: All declared fields, including computed fields that CSMIR inlines.

path.description: JSON pointer; empty string denotes the document root.

ModelFile.description: An invalid file never exposes metadata from a previous successful load.

annotations.description: Metadata per Ossie origin; conformed dimensions keep every binding.

data_type.description: Exact logical type, e.g. INT64, DECIMAL(18,2), TIMESTAMPTZ (instant).

nullable.description:
Direct dimension binding nullability. Null means not inferred for
computed dimensions or metrics, whose result has not been executed.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation, safe to show; never internal errors.

public_origin.description: Configured application origin, present only for an origin rejection.

type.description: Problem type URI; `about:blank` means the HTTP status says it all.

QueryRequest.description: An aggregate query over an allowlisted dataset. No SQL is accepted.

filters.description: Conditions on dimensions, combined with AND.

sort.description: Ordering by selected fields; ties are broken by the dimensions.

rows.description:
Rows in column order. Every non-null value is a string in its column's
type (`integer` and `decimal` are exact; `null` means missing).

Select.description: How a selection of the member returns its values.

limit.description: The row limit the plan applied, when the query set one.

rows.description:
One array per row, one cell per column; `null` is a missing value,
or any value of a masked column.

SemanticCatalog.description: What the session can use of the project, to discover it (#140).

models.description:
In the order of their files; only models with a metric the session
can use. Empty is a valid answer: it tells nothing of what is hidden.

SemanticCell.description:
One present value: exact decimal text for DECIMAL and INT64, the text
of a VARCHAR, `YYYY-MM-DD` for a DATE and an RFC 3339 instant in UTC for
a TIMESTAMPTZ; a BOOLEAN as `true` or `false`.

id.description: The stable identifier of the metric or dimension.

masked.description:
Values withheld by the decision: every cell is `null`, unlike a
column whose `null` cells are missing values.

nullable.description: Always `true` today: a metric or a dimension may yield `null`.

timezone.description:
The governed IANA zone of a time bucket: where its days begin. An
instant needs none, it travels in UTC.

SemanticDenial.description: A use the session's roles do not allow.

name.description: Only for objects the query named; what the plan reads stays unnamed.

path.description: JSON pointer into the request, when the binder knows it.

SemanticExplanation.description: The answer: what was decided, the certified plan and its receipt.

oneOf.description: Filter over this query's metric selections (`HAVING`).

selections.description: Output columns, in order. The selected dimensions are the grain.

SemanticReceipt.description: Fingerprints of everything the answer depended on.

context.description:
The verified session's row-policy values, as an HMAC under a secret
of this instance: equal within one instance for the same project,
principal and values; never comparable across restarts, never the
values.

SemanticRejection.description: A query the engine cannot answer as asked, with stable diagnostics.

SemanticResult.description: The rows of every block of a query, with their exact column contract.

SemanticRun.description:
The answer of one execution: rows, receipt and notices, as one JSON
body of at most 4 MiB.

SemanticRunFingerprints.description:
The query's fingerprint, which anyone can derive from `query.sqir`, and
the others protected under this instance's key and for this principal:
the plain ones cover what this session may not see (hidden policies and
definitions, the policy files, the principal and its roles), and a
dictionary of guesses would reproduce them. Comparable within one
instance and for one principal, never across restarts.

context.description: The protected fingerprint of the row-policy values (#204).

SemanticRunNotice.description:
A selected metric that is deprecated, as its authorized definition
declares it.

replacement.description: Only a replacement this session may see.

SemanticRunQuery.description: The query, as its canonical intent with typed literals.

SemanticRunReceipt.description:
What the answer depended on, as far as this session may see it. `id` is
SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 (JCS) form of this object without `id`,
`read_started_at` and `read_finished_at`: anyone recomputes it from what
is shown. It identifies that content; it is no signature, and proves
neither who issued it nor that whoever handed it over changed nothing.

definitions.description:
The selected metrics and dimensions this session may see, with the
fingerprint of their content. The projection may be incomplete:
reproducing the answer needs authorized access to all its evidence.

evidence.description:
Opaque commitment to the evidence not shown, under this instance's
key and for this principal: comparable within one instance and for
one principal, never across restarts.

read_started_at.description:
When this read began (RFC 3339, UTC): the time of this execution,
never of a refresh of its sources.

sources.description: The datasets read that this session may see.

data_snapshot.description:
The DuckLake snapshot observed in the transaction that read the
rows, as decimal text; `null` for a source with no persistent
version, which cannot be read again as it was. Observed, not
retained: no promise that it can still be read.

dataset.description: The dataset's stable identifier; never its physical relation.

source_refreshed_at.description: When the source itself was last refreshed; `null` while unknown.

id.description: Query-local name of the column; ordering and `having` use it.

name.description: The metric's name in the model.

roles.description: Relationship roles it is reached through, when ambiguous.

timezone.description: IANA zone overriding the governed one.

oneOf.description: A metric selection of this query, by its `id`.
A unit of the model's own namespace.

SemanticUnit.description: The declared unit of a column's values.

oneOf.description: Exact decimal text (`"12.50"`), never a binary float.

value.description: Exact decimal text (`"12.50"`), never a binary float.

SemanticValue.description: A literal as written; binding types it after its target.

data_scope.description: Server-derived restriction. This session grants no access to real sources.
